name: Squarespace
tagline: Hosted website builder for portfolios, businesses, blogs, and stores

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked; 2026 public coverage lists Basic around $25/month monthly and lower annual pricing.

verdictSummary: A portfolio or marketing site is easy to build, but Squarespace's paid value is templates, editor, hosting, commerce/forms, domains, and support.
coreLoopDIY: Generate a static site from templates, add a small CMS, host it, and configure domain/forms.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because it removes design, hosting, and maintenance from the website project.

priorArt.name: WordPress
priorArt.desc: Open-source CMS/site platform; a practical alternative for many Squarespace use cases.

notes: Mainstream and useful; verdict depends on site complexity.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Squarespace (Hosted website builder for portfolios, businesses, blogs, and stores). Requirements:

- Core loop: Generate a static site from templates, add a small CMS, host it, and configure domain/forms.
- Needs: static hosting.
- Needs: domain/DNS.
- Needs: CMS or Markdown.
- Needs: form/email service.
- Needs: template system.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: template quality; editor; hosting.
